{"consolidated_memory":"Component: search/query/rewriter.ts (search side)
Problem: Empty result set in the query rewriter (occurred on two separate occasions)

OCCASION 1: [2026-02-21]
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Repro: Search for a two word phrase with a stop word
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Signal: Rewritten query with no clauses left
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #3598 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1
- Measured outcome: Flaky test went from 37 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 2: [2026-05-02]
- Trigger: After a rolling restart of the fleet
- Repro: Search for a two word phrase with a stop word
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Signal: Rewritten query with no clauses left
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #4143 on branch fix/empty-result-set-2
- Measured outcome: Error rate dropped from 8.1 percent to under 1 per ten thousand

Note: Both incidents affected the same corner of search/query/rewriter.ts with overlapping context, but had distinct root causes, fixes, and outcomes. The repro steps were identical but the triggering conditions and underlying causes were different."}
